contexts.text: In place of spiritual temptations, there (now) are sadnesses, etc.
Sad and troublesome things are removed in an instant, (and then) the Angels inflow and communicate their happiness.
To those in evil... the bliss in the affection of good and truth appears... as something sad...
Those in this state perceive... how sad... is the life of those who are in the evils of the love of self and of the world.
The narrow way at first appeared sad and dark.
When the spiritual life is mentioned, or the spiritual sense, it is (then) like something sad... AC 5006:2.
This zeal, in the internal form, is not anger... but a certain sadness...
A sad lot awaits (these pleasure-seekers). Described.
Sadness produces weeping...
This thought (that others are not the elect) when communicated, induces what is sad, which, according to a law of order (there) returns to those (who entertain it).
This sadness is turned into grief, and the grief into anger.
(The idea) that joy in Heaven is to serve others by doing them good, without any reflection of merit or recompense, comes to them as what is sad.
That they were in a sad state. Signified.
From what affection was the sadness. Signified, Explained.
Those in the province of the kidneys, etc., chastise (by) inducing things undelightful and sad.

Spirits sent out of some infernal Society into the sphere of a man's life, speak together about things which are adverse to the man, whence there generally inflows what is... undelightful, sad, or anxious, with much variety.
The delight from these loves is... after death turned into what is sad and shocking.
Sadness of the scientifics of the Church. Signified, Explained.
The sadness here means sadness, because the good of the Church had left the scientifics...
The child (Moses) wept = sadness.
It is these cares (about worldly things) which induce on minds, and thence on faces, what is sad and anxious.
Whence there comes to man the interior sadness which is called melancholy. (Fully Explained. See Anxiety.)
Man has no need to go with a sad and moaning face...
Those who have renounced the world... in the other life are sad in genius and life, HH 528:2. HH 535.
Compulsory worship is... sad, because there is no delight of Heaven in it.
When (celibates) feel the sphere of conjugial love there, they become sad and anxious.
The novitiate Spirits went away sad.
The Angels... perceived a sadness in me. (Its cause ex.)
That from sadnesses (there), come the Delights of intelligence. Explained.
This fire... in a spiritual idea, appeared as what is sad: such is the life in them. Explained.

When the Angels with man are in such things, and speak together about them... and when such things are not in the faith and affection of the man, there inflows sadness, and inquietude... although he may then be thinking about something quite different.
I was in a sad state, but did not know the cause. (See Heavenly doctrine.)
Under Melancholy, see this reference.
I perceived an influx now of sadness, now of cheerfulness... and I perceived there were Spirits... who had explored what things are a source of sadness to me, and had spoken together about them...
(Societies of friendship cause) a sadness in me. Explained.
To be sad () = to toil at.
Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sadness () = insanity in spiritual things, and aversion.
All sadness and grief of mind proceed from an assault on the love.
Her virgins are sad () = that the affections of truth have been destroyed.
